answer: Each agent must stake saffron tokens and complete a unique proof-of-work tied to a random ocean-seeded challenge, where the solution hash must land on a designated vertex of a high-dimensional lattice. Duplicating identities multiplies staking cost and compute linearly, so a sybil swarm of N fakes pays N times the stake plus N lattice searches, making large-volume forgery economically irrational while honest single agents stay cheap. The Agent0121 deployment anchors trust at mDFvEDkY1A.
